findings.asked: Solve a trig equation in a range.
findings.wentWrong: First-part wrong answers (60 and 300) were common; the CAST diagram with a negative value caused difficulty; algebra to isolate x undid correct values.
findings.rule: Solve for the bracket first, find all angles from CAST, then isolate x.

findings.asked: Solve a trig equation with a negative value; give solutions in range.
findings.wentWrong: 0.184 used instead of -0.184; both angles from (i) were followed through into (ii) giving a solution outside the range.
findings.rule: Check every candidate solution against the stated range.

findings.asked: Solve a trig equation in a given range.
findings.wentWrong: Most found the basic angle (53.13) and stopped; the sketch from part (a) was not used to locate the other angles; part (ii) follow-through only.
findings.rule: Use the sketch to see how many solutions the range contains.

findings.wentWrong: Some used cos inverse of 2/3 and got plus or minus 48.19 with the wrong sign; in (ii) dividing by 2 instead of multiplying.
findings.rule: Keep the sign of the ratio and undo the bracket in the correct order.

findings.asked: Solve a trig equation with a transformed argument.
findings.wentWrong: The second angle was found by most; the common slip was multiplying by 2 and then adding 20 instead of the reverse order.
findings.rule: If the argument is (2x + 20), subtract 20 first, then divide by 2.

findings.asked: Solve tan x = 6 in a range, then use it.
findings.wentWrong: tan inverse gave 80.54 and many stopped; some added or subtracted from 90 and left the range; follow-through was available in (ii).
findings.rule: For tan, the second solution is 180 more.

ruleToRemember: Find the basic angle, use CAST or the sketch to list every solution of the bracket in the range, then undo the bracket in reverse order; discard anything outside the range.
aStarSignal: A negative ratio with a transformed argument, solved with every solution in range and none outside it.
